title: trowel32
description: a small retexture for theendercore's trowel mod.
body:
# trowel 32x

this is a resource pack containing only one texture for the [theendercore's trowel](https://modrinth.com/mod/trowel) mod.

i find it annoying to not have all of my textures in one resolution. this retexture makes the trowel more visually passable alongside larger 32x resource packs for my sake and now your's.
